BiblicalUsage: Ahuzzath is named once: he came with Abimelech and Phichol to Isaac at Beersheba to make a covenant, because they could see the Lord was with him.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on this friend. But the scene he walked into is worth keeping: enemies came to make a covenant because they could see God was with Isaac — and I hold that as a picture of what a godly life does to its neighbours.
RelatedPeople: Ahuzzath; Isaac; Abimelech, King of Gerar
